info.title: ai-bridge
info.description: A lightweight, language-agnostic CLI tool for packing project source code into AI-readable context and applying AI-generated code changes back to your codebase.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: AI Bridge - Connects your local codebase to AI chatbots.

commands.name: init
commands.description: Scaffolds .aiignore, AutoIndexMode/, and skills/ for a new project.

commands.name: apply
commands.description: Applies ai-response.xml patches to the codebase.

options.name: --watch
options.description: Keep running and auto-apply when ai-response.xml is saved. [default: False]

commands.name: migrate
commands.description: Updates local project AI instructions to match the globally installed tool version.

commands.name: pack
commands.description: Packs source files into text context for AI.
